title: Sandbox/debug `stunUnit` move does not produce a stun that Solari Shrine's trigger recognizes (only writes meta.__flags.stunned, not top-level meta.stunned that the die-event snapshot reads).
expected: game-definition/moves/counters.ts:162-166 stunUnit only calls counters.setFlag(cardId,"stunned",true) (writes meta.__flags.stunned). Die-event emitters read top-level meta.stunned: cleanup/state-based-checks.ts:596 `wasStunned: unitMeta?.stunned === true` (damage-death path used by Hextech Ray etc.) and abilities/effects/kill.ts:193 `meta?.stunned === true`. trigger-matcher.ts:420 rejects the 'stunned' filter when event.wasStunned !== true. Real stun effect (abilities/effects/stun.ts:16-24) mirrors to top-level meta.stunned via updateCardMeta, which is why Rune Prison works. Snapshot (apps/riftbound-app/server/snapshot.ts:377) reads __flags.stunned first, so it shows stunned=true despite triggers not seeing it.
observed: Enemy Recruit stunned via stunUnit (snapshot meta.stunned=true), Shrine ready, killed by Hextech Ray / Dancing Grenade / Super Mega Death Rocket cast by player-1 -> no chain item, no opt-in prompt, no draw (3 separate attempts, base and battlefield). Same kills on units stunned by a real stun spell (Rune Prison, Facebreaker) triggered correctly. abilities/effects/stun.ts mirrors the flag to meta.stunned; game-definition/moves/counters.ts stunUnit only calls counters.setFlag.
